L1.text: A point marks an exact position. It has no size.

L2.text: A line segment has two endpoints and a fixed length you can measure.

L3.text: A line has no endpoints and continues forever in both directions.

L4.text: Drawing it longer on paper does not make a different line; paper shows only part.

L5.text: A ray has one endpoint and continues forever in one direction.

L6.text: Ray AB starts at A and passes through B, so ray BA points the other way.

L7.text: In our example, both rays start at O: ray OA and ray OB. They point in opposite directions, so they are different rays.

L8.text: Which figure has one endpoint and continues in one direction? Tap it.
